{{Quote|Javis Tyrr, average size, perfect hair, smirk that begs to be wiped off with a blaster?|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], describing Javis Tyrr|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>}}
'''Javis Tyrr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], Tyrr was present in the [[Temple district/Legends|Temple Precinct]] when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jysella Horn]]&mdash;who had just come down with an [[Force psychosis|enigmatic madness]]&mdash;dueled her [[The Unit|friends]] [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]] and [[Bazel Warv]]. Tyrr recorded the duel and Horn's subsequent capture by [[Galactic Alliance Security]] forces. For his highly successful coverage of this event, Tyrr was given his own weekly show, called ''[[Javis Tyrr Presents: The Jedi Among Us]]''. He later followed [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Jagged Fel]] to the [[Indigo Tower]] where [[Lina Zev]] and [[Karn Valanti]] were posing as their doubles. He soon discovered this deception after noticing discrepancies in their voices and the fact that Fel's double didn't have his scar.

Because of Tyrr's frequent meddling, Fel created the codename "Mynock" to represent the journalist.

Tyrr was present at the [[Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition]] when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Natua Wan]] also contracted the Force psychosis. He recorded the resulting [[Skirmish at the Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition|chaos]], at the same time attempting to pry an interview from Jaina Solo.

Tyrr also managed to obtain information about [[Seff Hellin]]'s imprisonment inside the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]], which he released to the public. This led to a furious statement from [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] and also exposed the secret organization [[Darkmeld]].

Tyrr was despised by many, and some other journalists believed him to be an insult to their profession. When the [[Trial of Tahiri Veila]] began, [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]] [[Wynn Dorvan]] found out that, during Tyrr's work for [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]], Tyrr had conducted illegal espionage. Using this information, Daala ordered Dorvan to get rid of Tyrr. Tyrr was soon after arrested for illegal espionage.

His favorite drink was [[Crème D'Infame]].
